bourne.bp_t1_adj_caption: Speeds hold each condition's P/m constant as the working volume grows — set as discrete setpoints when the volume reaches each milestone. ⚠ Some values were clamped to the reactor RPM range; the target P/m cannot be held at those steps.
bourne.bp_t1_ctr_info: Default centre (Sarafinas 2018): **P/m = 0.2 W/kg** at **N = 425 RPM**. Within reactor range (50–1000 RPM).
bourne.bp_t1_verdict: ⚠️ **Sensitive** — 1 of 1 KPI(s) changed ≥ 5% (Yield (11.1%)). Response moved across the 100× P/m range, so **mixing matters**. Proceed to **Test 2** to distinguish micro- vs meso-mixing.
bourne.bp_t2_verdict: ⚠️ **Sensitive** — 1 of 1 KPI(s) changed ≥ 5% (Yield (11.1%)). Feed rate matters — the response is **consistent with mesomixing** (feed-plume dispersion). Proceed to **Test 3** to distinguish meso- vs macro-mixing.
bourne.bp_t3_verdict: ✅ **Not sensitive** — no KPI changed ≥ 5% across 1 KPI(s). The response is **consistent with macromixing**. Scale-up: keep **blend/circulation times short** (bulk homogeneity governs the outcome).
bourne.bp_summary:
### Decision-tree conclusion

- **Test 1:** sensitive to impeller speed → mixing matters.
- **Test 2:** sensitive to feed rate.
- **Test 3:** insensitive to feed location.

**Dominant regime: MACROMIXING.** Scale-up rule: **keep blend/circulation times short** — bulk homogeneity governs the outcome.

sensitivity.ms_kinetics_md:
**Kinetic model** (order pseudo-1): −dC/dt = k'·C

Characteristic reaction time **t_rxn = 69 s** (specified directly). This is the initial-rate time constant used in every Damköhler comparison below — the shortest (most conservative) estimate for mixing sensitivity.
sensitivity.ms_dt_ad_caption: ΔT_ad = |ΔH|·C₀·1000/(ρ·Cp) ≈ **2 K**  -  Thermal severity: low; the exothermic profile is modest and heat-transfer capability is likely adequate, though a heat balance should still be checked.
sensitivity.ms_da_caption: **TMA EasyMax-102** at 525 RPM, 0.055 L, Methanol — Re = 12,168, P/V = 0.294 W/L, θ₉₅ = 1.22 s, t_E = 0.0227 s  →  **Da_macro = 0.0176** (insensitive), **Da_micro = 0.000329** (insensitive).
sensitivity.ms_verdict: 🔴 **Mixing sensitivity confirmed** - the Bourne pre-screen shows a sensitivity, and the theoretical screen flags **micro/mesomixing** as likely. To pinpoint the controlling scale, complete Test 3 of the Bourne Protocol.

ms_findings_df.Finding: 🔴 Mixing sensitivity confirmed - Experimental pre-screen showed Yield changed with mixing conditions. Controlling scale not yet identified - complete Test 3 of the Bourne Protocol.
🟢 Unlikely - Da_micro = 0.000329 in TMA EasyMax-102 (525 RPM, 0.055 L): t_E = 0.0227 s vs t_rxn = 69 s.

🔴 Likely sensitive - Competing reactions present - both micromixing (local ε) and mesomixing (feed dispersion) may affect selectivity. In semi-batch operation the feed rate and feed location set the local concentration at the feed point (Bourne Tests 2 & 3).
🟢 Unlikely - Da_macro = 0.0176 in TMA EasyMax-102: θ₉₅ = 1.22 s vs t_rxn = 69 s. Blend time grows ~T^(2/3) at constant P/V - re-check at the next scale.

🟡 System-dependent - Multi-phase system - interphase transport may limit the observed rate. Characterise gas–liquid kLa and liquid–solid transport, including dissolution, adsorption, or desorption, for each reactor.
🟢 Manageable - |ΔH| = 10.0 kJ/mol, ΔT_ad ≈ 2 K - modest thermal load, unlikely to be limiting in most configurations.

ms_nextsteps_df.Recommended action: Complete Test 3 (feed location) to identify the controlling scale.
Assess Da_GL / Da_SL on the Vessel Assessment page.
